def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find rectangular frames of a single nonzero color, recording their
    # bounding boxes and interior patterns.
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if (r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2 or
            any(grid[r0][c] != color or grid[r1][c] != color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) or
            any(grid[r][c0] != color or grid[r][c1] != color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            continue
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        pat = [[grid[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] == color for j in range(iw)] for i in range(ih)]
        frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pat,sum(map(sum,pat))))

    if not frames:
        return out
    # The most internally patterned frame supplies the design.
    src = max(frames, key=lambda x: x[6])
    sh, sw = len(src[5]), len(src[5][0])
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pat,count in frames:
        if (color,r0,r1,c0,c1) == src[:5]:
            continue
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        # Project template to the interior dimensions.
        for i in range(ih):
            for j in range(iw):
                out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] = color if src[5][i*sh//ih][j*sw//iw] else 0
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frames = []

    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if (any(grid[r0][c] != color or grid[r1][c] != color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) or
            any(grid[r][c0] != color or grid[r][c1] != color for r in range(r0, r1+1))):
            continue
        pat = [[grid[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] == color
                for j in range(c1-c0-1)] for i in range(r1-r0-1)]
        frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pat, sum(map(sum, pat))))

    if not frames:
        return out

    # Use the frame with the most interior marks as the design.
    src = max(frames, key=lambda x: x[6])
    pat = src[5]
    ph, pw = len(pat), len(pat[0])

    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, _, _ in frames:
        if color == src[0]:
            continue
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        for i in range(ih):
            for j in range(iw):
                out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] = color if pat[i*ph//ih][j*pw//iw] else 0
    return out
